◆ Anomaly Arbitration ◆
Anomaly Arbitration is a series of extremely difficult challenges.
In Anomaly Arbitration, you will play against powerful enemies to bring equilibrium back to the world.
Each period of Anomaly Arbitration will feature 3 Knight stages and 1 King stage. Protected by the Knight stages, the King's strength will be greatly enhanced, making it difficult to defeat. Completing the 3 Knight stages will return the King stage to its regular difficulty.
Complete the battles to claim rich rewards, and meet specific conditions to earn additional Star Rewards.
The difficulty and rewards of Anomaly Arbitration are not affected by your Equilibrium Level.

Stages and rewards in Anomaly Arbitration are regularly updated.

You will be temporarily cut off from the outside world when entering the Anomaly Arbitration, with the following actions temporarily disabled:
● Changing team setups
● Changing, leveling up, or ascending Light Cones and Relics
● Leveling up or ascending characters
● Using Consumables in your Inventory

◆ Enemy Traits ◆
In Anomaly Arbitration, enemy materializations will have slight differences between them and regular enemies. Trailblazers can check out the details by reading about the enemies' traits when the battle begins.

◆ Arbitral Quadrant ◆
After each period of Anomaly Arbitration updates, several Arbitral Quadrant buff effects will be added to each King's challenge.
Before challenging the King, you can choose one of these buff effects for the team.

◆ Cycles ◆
In Anomaly Arbitration, every battle in the stage has its own independent Cycle limit. If the limit is exceeded during a challenge, it will be considered a failure. Clearing the battle within the designated number of Cycles and fulfilling specific conditions will grant a star rating for that stage.
In Anomaly Arbitration battles, the total action value of the first Cycle will be greatly increased, and the Cycle countdown will not reset when waves change.
When only a few Cycles remain, the team will be granted an additional combat buff at the start of each Cycle.

◆ Knight Stages ◆
The 3 Knight Stages must be challenged using 3 different character teams, and you can decide the order in which you challenge them.
After completing each Knight Stage, a record of the team will be saved. You can then use this fixed team to re-challenge that stage, with the following rules for repeat challenges:
● Team members are fixed. Their Path, Level, Traces, and Eidolons are updated when re-challenging.
● If you replace a team member's Light Cone or Relics with a Light Cone or Relics that were recorded from another team's successful run, the challenge progress for the Knight Stage that has a record of that Light Cone or Relic will be reset.
● If you replace a team member's Light Cone or Relics with those of another member of the same team, or with a Light Cone or Relics that do not exist in any of the recorded successful runs, you can proceed directly with the Knight Stage challenge. In this case, you can choose upon successful completion whether to replace the old Battle Records and team information with the new ones.

You can also reassemble your team lineup, swapping out characters, Light Cones, and Relics to re-challenge a Knight Stage, which will reset the challenge's progress.
Characters, Light Cones, and Relics on unchallenged teams can be freely changed, but they cannot duplicate those on a cleared team. If they do, the cleared team's challenge progress will be reset.
When a challenge's progress is reset, the team record for that Knight Stage will be erased, and the score for that stage will be invalidated.

Each Knight Stage's rating is calculated independently upon completion.
When you clear the same Knight Stage multiple times, the different ratings you acquire will not be combined.
The best battle record is calculated based on the highest total rating from all three Knight Stages at the same time. This record is then used to determine your Star Rewards, and resetting challenge progress will not affect this best record.

◆ King Stage ◆
In each Period's Anomaly Arbitration, there is only 1 King Stage, which can be challenged with any team.
It is recommended that you complete the Knight Stages first to restore the King Stage to its regular difficulty before challenging it.
If you directly defeat the King Stage on Plight difficulty, it will be considered as having cleared all three Knight Stages with 3 stars, and you will receive all the rewards from the Knight Stages.

◆ Reward Details ◆
Limited-time avatar frames and medals matching the star rating you achieve in the King Stage will be awarded.
● These limited-time avatar frames can be used during the current "Anomaly Arbitration" event.
● Medals can be equipped and displayed from the Collection Showcase in the Trailblazer's room. Medals will remain valid for 3 Anomaly Arbitration periods (including the current one). The specific validity is determined by the duration of the corresponding Anomaly Arbitration period.
